dialogue.text:
I read an old document I found once,<d=0.25/>
said that originally the pins were meant
to be stickers.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
Bunch of research stuff,<d=0.25/>
it was mostly uninteresting.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
There was never any mention of
WHY they were changed to pins.
dialogue.speaker: April

dialogue.text:
The docs suddenly started referring to them
as pins without any reason.
dialogue.speaker: April
